main_topic.h_title: See the National Park and the Lake at their brilliant best
main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Khao Sok National Park is a unique experience, unlike any other in Thailand. Float away on Cheow Lan lake and dive into the jungle with local guides who have lived here all their lives.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Interactive kids camp, elephant experience, full day lake trip, and more
Our packages connect you to the best of what Khao Sok has to offer, so you won't miss out on anything. Our friendly staff will take care of you all the way through your stay, offering peace of mind.

All of our packages include a visit to Khao Sok Lake, either as a day tour or overnight at the floating bungalows. There are options for everyone - families and groups, those who feel more adventurous, and those who prefer a more relaxed program.

main_topic.h_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages
main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Packages include meals, accommodation, and guided activities.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Step 1 : Pick a package with the activities you would like to experience
Step 2 : Decide when you would like to stay
Step 3 : Choose the Jungle House you would like to stay in
Step 4 : Select your preferred transfer if you need one, and we'll take care of the rest!

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Wildlife galore. The staff were friendly and amazing and the location is spectacular. We hired guides and they were absolutely wonderful. Dang was our guide for the majority of the trip and took great care of us!!! Enormously knowledgeable about the local wildlife and plants.

main_topic.h_title: Incredible place right in the heart of nature.
main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: So many fun activities to do (tubing, rafting, elephant visits, hikes, night safari, massages), super friendly and attentive staff, delicious food and the tree houses are gorgeous. Location is right next to the river. Seeing as it is in the jungle you can expect a few critters here and there - that s all part of it!

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Staff is very nice and helps you organize trips and shuttles to other places. Highly recommend booking the 3days 2 nights package with overnight stay in the lake, you will sleep in a floating bungalow which is a unique experience, as it is the whole trip, from the start from the

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: What a cool experience! 2 nights in a tree house, one nights got in a floating raft house. Rafting, Trekking, bamboo cooking, night hikes, elephants, safari's and more! Every view is so spectacular The whole package is structured to let you get the very most out of Khao Sok.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: We had a very nice stay at Our Jungle House, we stayed in the Romance tree house. Afterwards we spent an overnight stay in the Khao Sok floating bungalows. Everything was great! Good organization & fun excursions. Watching the limestone cliffs surrounding the lake was a total dream.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: We stayed 3 days and 2 nights. Our Jungle House was peaceful and clean. Monkeys were fun to watch. Cheow Lan Lake floating bungalows were beautiful. I loved swimming in the deep lake right outside my door. We made two safari runs on the long-tail boats to find jungle animals and loved it.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: Great place to switch off from everything as you are in the middle of the jungle. Really good organization in terms of tours: we did canoeing, bamboo rafting, 1-day visit to Khao Sok lake, hiking and two safaris. Sliding on a boat through the limestone cliffs has been fantastic.

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: We did the Explorer tour under our 3D2N package. Loved it. When you reach the Raratchaprapha dam, and the wonders begin. Sailing with the longtail boat, you will be stunned by the beauty of the cliffs. And when you see the Raft house I'm sure you'll feel like a childish happiness!

main_topic.main_title: Khao Sok and Cheow Lan Lake Packages

primary_content.text: We really enjoyed our stay here. The jungle house are nice and unique. The staff is friendly and helpful. We booked the family package and enjoyed every hour of it. We hope to come back in a few years when our second son is old enough to experience it!
